description: This is an API route module for authentication endpoints in a FastAPI application, including user login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh functionalities.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, returning a JWT token and user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Fetches the profile information of the currently authenticated (trusted/mock) user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile information of the trusted/mock user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Refreshes the access token for the trusted user (mock implementation).
